pages.title: Fifteen species
pages.text: B adds fifteen wild mushrooms. Eleven are cultivable in a mushroom bag; four are natural-only and reject the bag.

pages.title: Wild growth
pages.text: Wild mushrooms grow through three ages and can spread to nearby compatible soil. They need dirt, grass or another supported substrate.

pages.title: Mushroom bag
pages.text: The bag has four visible stages. It grows only within the species' temperature tolerance; below or above it, growth stops. A bag has a limited number of uses before it is spent.

pages.title: Natural-only
pages.text: Natural-only species are marked in the species registry. Right-clicking their bag input is rejected with a message; they cannot be cultivated.

pages.title: Mushroom bag
pages.text: Only the eleven cultivable species grow in the bag.

pages.title: Wild mushroom
pages.text: Wild species grow/spread on compatible soil; natural-only species reject the bag.
